summary: Event venue map with OpenStreetMap loaded only after consent, plus the address and directions links.
whenToUse: Showing where a meetup, conference or workshop takes place.
Offering directions to the venue with Google Maps, Apple Maps or OpenStreetMap.
whenNotToUse: Compact venue summaries in lists: use VenueCard with mapHref.
Maps with several points, routes or custom layers: integrate a dedicated mapping library.

props.name: name
props.description: Venue name, used in the iframe title, the placeholder and the links.

props.name: latitude / longitude
props.description: WGS84 coordinates of the venue, used for the marker and the directions.

props.name: address
props.description: Address shown in the caption inside an address element.

props.name: zoom
props.description: OpenStreetMap zoom level, clamped between 3 and 19.

props.name: isLoaded / defaultLoaded
props.description: Controlled or initial consent: the iframe is created only when true.

props.name: onLoadedChange
props.description: Called when the user loads the map; use it to remember the consent.

props.name: directions
props.description: External links shown below the map; an empty array hides them.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: CSS aspect ratio of the map area.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Custom placeholder content shown before consent, for example a static image.

props.name: consentNote
props.description: Replaces the default privacy note next to the load button.

inherits: HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> (without children), applied to the root figure.

keyboard.action: Reaches the "Load map" button, then the map and the directions links.
Loads the map from the placeholder button.

accessibility: Before consent the illustrated placeholder is decorative; the venue name and the privacy note are readable text.
The iframe has a title that includes the venue name and is loaded lazily and sandboxed.
External links announce that they open in a new tab.
After loading, focus moves to the map because the button disappears.
The address remains available as text even when the map is not loaded.
responsive: The map fills the container width and keeps the aspectRatio proportions.
In narrow containers the consent box uses smaller spacing and text thanks to container queries.
customization: Customize colors and borders with the --dc-color-* tokens and --dc-look-radius-container.
Pass placeholder to show a static image of the area instead of the illustration.
commonMistakes: Setting defaultLoaded to true without previously collected consent: the request to OpenStreetMap would fire on first render.
Swapping latitude and longitude: latitude comes first (e.g. 45.48 for Milan).
limits: Uses the public OpenStreetMap embed: no custom styles, multiple markers or routes.
Consent is not persisted: store it yourself via onLoadedChange.
